learning_outcomes.text: The knowledge and understanding of a broad field of fundamental sciences and the associated ability for analysis and synthesis.
The ability to mobilize the resources of a specific scientific and technical field.
Mastery of engineering methods and tools: identification, modeling, and solving of even unfamiliar and incompletely defined problems, the use of computer tools, analysis, and system design.

syllabus_topics: Generalities on PDEs and boundary value problems.
Hyperbolic equations and systems in two variables.
Weak formulation and Theory of Distributions.
Brief introduction to the finite element method.
bibliography: R. Petit L’outil mathématique pour la physique Dunod, 1998.
